title: VoidStep
description: A minecraft Mod that adds two new items into the game, magical pearl and ender dagger. Ender dagger had special ability to teleport you 8 blocks towards the direction you are facing when you right click with a 2 second cooldown.
body:
voidstep is a mod that adds 2 different new items in minecraft. one being magical pearl and other ender dagger. Magical pearl can be found in the end and used to make ender dagger. It can be used to make ender dagger by combiling two of the pearl with a iron block. The Ender Dagger can be used to teleport 8 blocks towards the direction you are facing. You can use right click on the sword to teleport. It has a 2 second cooldown.
